requested_label: inland saline or alkaline aquatic environment
definition: An aquatic environment which is determined by an inland water body whose water is substantially more saline than fresh water, substantially more alkaline than circumneutral water, or both.
exact_synonym: Non-marine Saline and Alkaline|inland saline waters|saline inland waters|continental saline waters
notes: Definition curated from the committed deep-research report for this record (#110, #185). The “or both” wording preserves GOLD's disjunctive hierarchy instead of claiming every child is simultaneously saline and alkaline. “Inland” is preferred to “non-marine” because marine-derived inland brines can remain geographically inland, while “athalassohaline” is not an exact synonym because it classifies water by ionic composition rather than location. Parent replacement is intentional: GOLD's inherited aquatic-biome edge is false for the node's operated-setting descendants, whereas ENVO's aquatic-environment genus covers both natural and engineered water-determined settings. Dropped the exact synonym 'Non-marine-Saline-and-Alkaline' (#213): it is BacDive's label for the concept GOLD spells 'Non-marine Saline and Alkaline', and the two differ only in punctuation. Both source labels survive on the record's source_attestations, where they identify which source said what; as a pair of EXACT synonyms they would read to an ENVO editor as the same string written twice. Found by the guard added for this issue, not by the review that filed it.

definition: Air which is contained within the interior space of a building or other roofed construction, and which is thereby separated from the outdoor atmosphere by that structure's envelope.
